source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

# ============================================================
# 1. IDENTIFY CURRENT & BASELINE RUNS FROM SQL SUMMARY
# ============================================================
current_run  <- db_run_summary %>% filter(sequence_num == max(sequence_num)) %>% slice(1)
baseline_run <- db_run_summary %>% filter(sequence_num == min(sequence_num)) %>% slice(1)

current_run_id  <- current_run$run_id[1]
baseline_run_id <- baseline_run$run_id[1]
has_baseline    <- (current_run_id != baseline_run_id)

project_name  <- current_run$project_name[1]
scenario_name <- current_run$test_name[1]

applications <- db_app_summary %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  arrange(app_name) %>%
  pull(app_name)
application_list <- paste(applications, collapse = ", ")

current_duration  <- paste0(current_run$duration_mins[1], " mins")
baseline_duration <- paste0(baseline_run$duration_mins[1], " mins")

current_start_fmt  <- format(current_run$start_time[1], "%d %b %Y, %I:%M %p")
current_end_fmt    <- format(current_run$end_time[1], "%I:%M %p")
baseline_start_fmt <- format(baseline_run$start_time[1], "%d %b %Y, %I:%M %p")
baseline_end_fmt   <- format(baseline_run$end_time[1], "%I:%M %p")

rt_metric_name   <- toupper(rt_metric)
rt_column_title  <- paste(rt_metric_name, "Response Time")

# ============================================================
# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS FOR DELTAS & BADGES
# ============================================================
status_colour <- function(status) {
  if (identical(status, "PASS")) return("#16A34A")
  if (identical(status, "FAIL")) return("#DC2626")
  "#64748B"
}

metric_badge <- function(value, passed, suffix = "") {
  sprintf(
    "<span class='%s'>%s%s</span>",
    ifelse(isTRUE(passed), "status-pass", "status-fail"),
    value,
    suffix
  )
}

inline_delta_badge <- function(current_val, baseline_val, lower_is_better = FALSE) {
  if (!has_baseline || is.na(current_val) || is.na(baseline_val)) return("")
  if (baseline_val == 0) {
    if (current_val == 0) return("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-neutral'>▬ 0.0%</span>")
    cls <- if (lower_is_better) "hd-delta-fail" else "hd-delta-pass"
    return(sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline %s'>▲ New</span>", cls))
  }
  delta <- round(((current_val - baseline_val) / baseline_val) * 100, 1)
  if (delta == 0) {
    return("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-neutral'>▬ 0.0%</span>")
  }
  is_good <- if (lower_is_better) (delta < 0) else (delta > 0)
  cls     <- if (is_good) "hd-delta-pass" else "hd-delta-fail"
  arrow   <- if (delta > 0) "▲" else "▼"
  sign_ch <- if (delta > 0) "+" else "-"
  sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline %s'>%s %s%.1f%%</span>", cls, arrow, sign_ch, abs(delta))
}

delta_text <- function(current_val, baseline_val, lower_is_better = FALSE) {
  if (is.na(current_val) || is.na(baseline_val)) return("—")
  if (baseline_val == 0) {
    if (current_val == 0) return("<span class='status-na'>▬ 0%</span>")
    return("<span class='status-fail'>▲ Increase</span>")
  }
  delta <- round(((current_val - baseline_val) / baseline_val) * 100, 1)
  if (delta == 0) return("<span class='status-na'>▬ 0%</span>")
  is_good <- if (lower_is_better) (delta < 0) else (delta > 0)
  cls     <- if (is_good) "status-pass" else "status-fail"
  arrow   <- if (delta > 0) "▲" else "▼"
  sign_ch <- if (delta > 0) "+" else "-"
  sprintf("<span class='%s'>%s %s%.1f%%</span>", cls, arrow, sign_ch, abs(delta))
}

safe_dom_id <- function(x) {
  gsub("^_+|_+$", "", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", as.character(x)))
}

# ============================================================
# 2B. INFRASTRUCTURE EVIDENCE (CPU / Memory screenshots)
#     Drop images into <evidence_dir>/<run_id>/ (default: Evidence/<run_id>/)
#     Optional <run_id>/evidence.yaml maps "filename.png: Caption text".
#     Nothing found => no tab, no button, report is unchanged.
# ============================================================
evidence_root <- if (!is.null(params_cfg$evidence_dir) && nzchar(trimws(params_cfg$evidence_dir))) params_cfg$evidence_dir else "Evidence"
if (!grepl("^(//|\\\\\\\\|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|/)", evidence_root)) evidence_root <- here::here(evidence_root)

collect_evidence <- function(run_id) {
  rid <- as.character(run_id)
  cand_dirs <- unique(c(
    file.path(evidence_root, rid),
    here::here("RawResults", rid, "evidence"),
    here::here("RawResults", rid)
  ))
  existing_dirs <- cand_dirs[dir.exists(cand_dirs)]
  if (length(existing_dirs) == 0) return(NULL)

  files <- character(0)
  active_dir <- NULL
  for (d in existing_dirs) {
    found <- list.files(d, pattern = "\\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp)$", ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(found) > 0) {
      files <- found[order(basename(found))]
      active_dir <- d
      break
    }
  }
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  captions <- tryCatch({
    yml <- file.path(active_dir, "evidence.yaml")
    if (file.exists(yml)) yaml::read_yaml(yml) else list()
  }, error = function(e) list())
  lapply(files, function(f) {
    cap <- captions[[basename(f)]]
    if (is.null(cap)) cap <- gsub("\\s+", " ", gsub("[_-]+", " ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))))
    list(caption = as.character(cap), uri = knitr::image_uri(f))
  })
}

render_evidence_cards <- function(items) {
  paste(vapply(items, function(it) {
    sprintf('<figure class="hd-evidence-card"><figcaption>%s</figcaption><img src="%s" alt="%s" /></figure>',
            htmlEscape(it$caption), it$uri, htmlEscape(it$caption))
  }, character(1)), collapse = "\n")
}

evidence_cur  <- collect_evidence(current_run_id)
evidence_base <- if (has_baseline) collect_evidence(baseline_run_id) else NULL
has_evidence  <- !is.null(evidence_cur) || !is.null(evidence_base)

evidence_tab_ids <- character(0)
evidence_tabs_html <- ""
evidence_panels_html <- ""
if (has_evidence) {
  groups <- list()
  if (!is.null(evidence_cur))  groups$CURRENT  <- list(title = sprintf("Current Run #%s", current_run_id),  items = evidence_cur)
  if (!is.null(evidence_base)) groups$BASELINE <- list(title = sprintf("Baseline Run #%s", baseline_run_id), items = evidence_base)

  evidence_tab_ids <- c("ALL", names(groups))
  n_all <- sum(vapply(groups, function(g) length(g$items), integer(1)))
  tabs <- sprintf('<label for="hd-tab-evidence-ALL" class="hd-modal-tab-btn" data-mode="evidence" data-tab-id="ALL">All Evidence (%d)</label>', n_all)
  for (gid in names(groups)) {
    tabs <- paste0(tabs, sprintf('<label for="hd-tab-evidence-%s" class="hd-modal-tab-btn" data-mode="evidence" data-tab-id="%s">%s (%d)</label>',
                                 gid, gid, groups[[gid]]$title, length(groups[[gid]]$items)))
  }
  evidence_tabs_html <- tabs

  group_html <- function(g) sprintf('<h4 class="hd-evidence-heading">%s</h4><div class="hd-evidence-grid">%s</div>', htmlEscape(g$title), render_evidence_cards(g$items))
  evidence_panels_html <- paste(
    c(
      sprintf('<div id="evidence-data-ALL" class="hd-tab-panel">%s</div>', paste(vapply(groups, group_html, character(1)), collapse = "\n")),
      vapply(names(groups), function(gid) sprintf('<div id="evidence-data-%s" class="hd-tab-panel">%s</div>', gid, group_html(groups[[gid]])), character(1))
    ),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 3. EVALUATE RUN-LEVEL, APP-LEVEL & SCENARIO-LEVEL SLAs
# ============================================================
current_key <- as.character(current_run_id)
vu_status   <- "PASS"
vu_actual   <- format(round(current_run$total_users[1], 0), big.mark = ",")
vu_target   <- ">= 1"

if (!is.null(sla_results[[current_key]])) {
  vu_rules <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$metric, "total_users"), sla_results[[current_key]]$rules)
  if (length(vu_rules) > 0) {
    vu_rule   <- vu_rules[[1]]
    vu_status <- ifelse(isTRUE(vu_rule$passed), "PASS", "FAIL")
    vu_actual <- format(round(vu_rule$actual, 0), big.mark = ",")
    vu_target <- paste0(vu_rule$operator, " ", vu_rule$threshold)
  }
}

rt_summary <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)

# Map label RT outcomes onto Scenarios
cur_scen_map <- db_label_scen_map %>% filter(run_id == current_run_id)

joined_labels_all <- tibble(
  app_name = character(), logical_scenario = character(), label = character(),
  actual_rt = numeric(), threshold = numeric(), passed = logical(),
  breach_pct = numeric(), tx_count = integer(), errors = integer(), error_rate = numeric()
)

logical_rt_summary <- tibble(
  app_name = character(), logical_scenario = character(),
  total_labels = integer(), passed_labels = integer(), failed_labels = integer(),
  logical_rt_passed = logical(), worst_label = character(),
  worst_actual = numeric(), worst_sla = numeric(), worst_breach_pct = numeric()
)

if (!is.null(rt_summary) && !is.null(rt_summary$all_labels) && nrow(rt_summary$all_labels) > 0) {
  joined_labels_all <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    inner_join(cur_scen_map, by = c("run_id", "label")) %>%
    distinct(app_name, logical_scenario, label, actual_rt, threshold, passed, breach_pct, tx_count, errors, error_rate)

  logical_rt_summary <- joined_labels_all %>%
    group_by(app_name, logical_scenario) %>%
    summarise(
      total_labels      = n(),
      passed_labels     = sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      failed_labels     = sum(!passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      logical_rt_passed = all(passed),
      worst_label       = if (any(!passed)) label[which.max(breach_pct)] else "-",
      worst_actual      = if (any(!passed)) max(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else 0,
      worst_sla         = if (any(!passed)) threshold[which.max(breach_pct)] else 0,
      worst_breach_pct  = if (any(!passed)) max(breach_pct, na.rm = TRUE) else 0,
      .groups           = "drop"
    )
}

# Build Scenario Health DF (grouped by clean Scenario name)
logical_health_df <- db_logical_scenario_summary %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  left_join(logical_rt_summary, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    logical_rt_passed  = ifelse(is.na(logical_rt_passed), TRUE, logical_rt_passed),
    scenario_rt_passed = logical_rt_passed,
    failed_labels      = ifelse(is.na(failed_labels), 0L, failed_labels),
    thread_group       = logical_scenario
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    error_target    = get_app_error_threshold(app_name),
    error_passed    = error_rate <= error_target,
    scenario_passed = isTRUE(logical_rt_passed) && isTRUE(error_passed)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

scenario_health_df <- logical_health_df

# Scenario SLA counts
logical_scen_total    <- nrow(logical_health_df)
logical_rt_passed_cnt <- sum(logical_health_df$logical_rt_passed, na.rm = TRUE)
logical_rt_failed_cnt <- logical_scen_total - logical_rt_passed_cnt
logical_er_passed_cnt <- sum(logical_health_df$error_passed, na.rm = TRUE)
logical_er_failed_cnt <- logical_scen_total - logical_er_passed_cnt

rt_status <- if (logical_rt_failed_cnt == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL"
er_status <- if (logical_er_failed_cnt == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL"

# Application-level Health + Baseline Deltas
cur_apps  <- db_app_summary %>% filter(run_id == current_run_id)
base_apps <- db_app_summary %>%
  filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>%
  select(
    app_name,
    base_tx         = transactions,
    base_throughput = throughput,
    base_pct_rt     = pct_rt,
    base_error_rate = error_rate
  )

app_logical_scen_counts <- logical_health_df %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(
    logical_total  = n(),
    logical_passed = sum(logical_rt_passed, na.rm = TRUE),
    logical_failed = sum(!logical_rt_passed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )

app_rt_breach_summary <- if (nrow(joined_labels_all) > 0) {
  joined_labels_all %>%
    group_by(app_name) %>%
    summarise(
      total_app_labels  = n(),
      passed_app_labels = sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      breach_count      = sum(!passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      worst_label       = if (any(!passed)) label[which.max(breach_pct)] else "-",
      worst_actual      = if (any(!passed)) max(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else 0,
      worst_sla         = if (any(!passed)) threshold[which.max(breach_pct)] else 0,
      .groups           = "drop"
    )
} else {
  tibble(app_name = character(), total_app_labels = integer(), passed_app_labels = integer(), breach_count = integer(), worst_label = character(), worst_actual = numeric(), worst_sla = numeric())
}

app_health <- cur_apps %>%
  left_join(base_apps, by = "app_name") %>%
  left_join(app_logical_scen_counts, by = "app_name") %>%
  left_join(app_rt_breach_summary, by = "app_name") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    throughput_target = get_app_tps_threshold(app_name),
    throughput_pass   = throughput >= throughput_target,
    error_target      = get_app_error_threshold(app_name),
    error_pass        = error_rate <= error_target,
    scenario_pass     = is.na(logical_failed) || logical_failed == 0,
    application_pass  = isTRUE(throughput_pass) && isTRUE(error_pass) && isTRUE(scenario_pass)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

tp_app_total  <- nrow(app_health)
tp_app_passed <- sum(app_health$throughput_pass, na.rm = TRUE)
tp_status     <- if (tp_app_passed == tp_app_total) "PASS" else "FAIL"

applications_total  <- nrow(app_health)
applications_passed <- sum(app_health$application_pass, na.rm = TRUE)
applications_failed <- applications_total - applications_passed

overall_status <- (vu_status == "PASS") &&
                  (tp_app_passed == tp_app_total) &&
                  (logical_er_passed_cnt == logical_scen_total) &&
                  (logical_rt_passed_cnt == logical_scen_total)

overall_icon   <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) "✅" else "❌"
overall_badge  <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>FAIL</span>"
topbar_class   <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) "hd-top-bar" else "hd-top-bar fail"
callout_class  <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) "hd-assessment-callout" else "hd-assessment-callout fail"

# ============================================================

} else ""

if (has_evidence) {
  evidence_btn_html <- '<label for="hd-mode-evidence" class="hd-modal-btn" data-open-mode="evidence" data-open-tab="ALL" style="background:#F0FDF4;border-color:#86EFAC;color:#166534;padding:3px 10px;margin:0;">🖥 Infrastructure 🔍</label>'

  top_bar_html <- sub(theme_marker, paste0(evidence_btn_html, theme_marker), top_bar_html, fixed = TRUE)

# Run-over-run latency delta used by the executive narrative
rt_delta_pct <- if (has_baseline && baseline_run$pct_rt[1] > 0) {
  round(((current_run$pct_rt[1] - baseline_run$pct_rt[1]) / baseline_run$pct_rt[1]) * 100, 1)
} else 0
tp_delta_pct <- if (has_baseline && baseline_run$throughput[1] > 0) {
  round(((current_run$throughput[1] - baseline_run$throughput[1]) / baseline_run$throughput[1]) * 100, 1)
} else 0
er_delta_pct <- if (has_baseline && baseline_run$error_rate[1] > 0) {
  round(((current_run$error_rate[1] - baseline_run$error_rate[1]) / baseline_run$error_rate[1]) * 100, 1)
} else 0

executive_narrative <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) {
  if (has_baseline) {
    sprintf(
      "Overall, <strong>Run #%s met all performance release criteria</strong> under peak load of <strong>%s virtual users</strong>, sustaining healthy throughput (<strong>%.2f TPS</strong>) with zero SLA breaches and a %s response time profile vs Baseline #%s.",
      current_run_id, vu_actual, current_run$throughput[1],
      ifelse(rt_delta_pct < 0, sprintf("%.1f%% faster", abs(rt_delta_pct)), "consistent"),
      baseline_run_id
    )
  } else {
    sprintf(
      "Overall, <strong>Run #%s met all performance release criteria</strong> under peak load of <strong>%s virtual users</strong>, sustaining healthy throughput (<strong>%.2f TPS</strong>) with zero SLA breaches.",
      current_run_id, vu_actual, current_run$throughput[1]
    )
  }
} else {
  fail_reasons <- c()
  if (vu_status != "PASS") fail_reasons <- c(fail_reasons, sprintf("target concurrency not met (achieved %s VU)", vu_actual))
  if (tp_status != "PASS") fail_reasons <- c(fail_reasons, sprintf("throughput SLA missed (%d/%d apps passed)", tp_app_passed, tp_app_total))
  if (logical_er_failed_cnt > 0) fail_reasons <- c(fail_reasons, sprintf("elevated error rate (%.2f%% across %s errors)", current_run$error_rate[1], format(current_run$failed_tx[1], big.mark = ",")))
  if (logical_rt_failed_cnt > 0) {
    breach_cnt <- if (!is.null(rt_summary)) rt_summary$failed_count else logical_rt_failed_cnt
    worst_info <- if (!is.null(rt_summary) && nrow(rt_summary$top_breaches) > 0) {
      sprintf(" (worst: <code>%s</code> at %s ms)", rt_summary$top_breaches$label[1], format(round(rt_summary$top_breaches$actual_rt[1]), big.mark = ","))
    } else ""
    fail_reasons <- c(fail_reasons, sprintf("%d response time SLA breach%s%s",
                                           breach_cnt, ifelse(breach_cnt > 1, "es", ""), worst_info))
  }
  reasons_str <- paste(fail_reasons, collapse = "; ")

  if (has_baseline) {
    lat_comp_str <- if (rt_delta_pct < -1) {
      sprintf("achieving a <strong>%.1f%% overall latency improvement</strong> over Baseline #%s", abs(rt_delta_pct), baseline_run_id)
    } else if (rt_delta_pct > 1) {
      sprintf("experiencing a <strong>+%.1f%% latency regression</strong> vs Baseline #%s", abs(rt_delta_pct), baseline_run_id)
    } else {
      sprintf("with stable overall latency vs Baseline #%s", baseline_run_id)
    }
    sprintf(
      "Under peak load of <strong>%s concurrent users</strong>, the system sustained healthy throughput (<strong>%.2f TPS</strong>) with near-zero errors (<strong>%.2f%%</strong>), %s. However, the run <strong>failed release criteria</strong> due to %s.",
      vu_actual, current_run$throughput[1], current_run$error_rate[1], lat_comp_str, reasons_str
    )
  } else {
    sprintf(
      "Under peak load of <strong>%s concurrent users</strong>, the system sustained <strong>%.2f TPS</strong> with <strong>%.2f%% error rate</strong>. However, the run <strong>failed release criteria</strong> due to %s.",
      vu_actual, current_run$throughput[1], current_run$error_rate[1], reasons_str
    )
  }
}

app_rows_html <- paste(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(app_health)), function(i) {
    r <- app_health[i, ]
    app_id_safe <- safe_dom_id(r$app_name)

    status_badge_inner <- if (isTRUE(r$application_pass)) {
      "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>"
    } else {
      "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
    }

    status_cell <- sprintf(
      "<label for='hd-mode-sla' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='sla' data-open-tab='%s' style='margin:0;'>%s 🔍</label>",
      app_id_safe,
      status_badge_inner
    )

    tx_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$transactions, r$base_tx, lower_is_better = FALSE)
    tp_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$throughput, r$base_throughput, lower_is_better = FALSE)
    rt_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$pct_rt, r$base_pct_rt, lower_is_better = TRUE)
    er_delta_html <- inline_delta_badge(r$error_rate, r$base_error_rate, lower_is_better = TRUE)

    tp_cell <- paste0(metric_badge(sprintf("%.2f TPS", r$throughput), r$throughput_pass), tp_delta_html)
    rt_cell <- paste0(
      metric_badge(sprintf("%s ms", format(round(r$pct_rt), big.mark = ",")), r$scenario_pass),
      rt_delta_html,
      if (!is.na(r$logical_failed) && r$logical_failed > 0) {
        sprintf(" <span style='font-size:10px;color:#DC2626;font-weight:600;'>(%d scenario breach%s)</span>",
                r$logical_failed, ifelse(r$logical_failed > 1, "es", ""))
      } else ""
    )
    er_cell <- paste0(metric_badge(sprintf("%.2f%%", r$error_rate), r$error_pass), er_delta_html)

    scen_btn <- sprintf(
      "<label for='hd-mode-scenario' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='scenario' data-open-tab='%s' style='margin:0;'>%s 🔍</label>",
      app_id_safe,
      metric_badge(sprintf("%d of %d", r$logical_passed, r$logical_total), r$scenario_pass)
    )

    sprintf(
      "<tr style='cursor:pointer;' data-open-mode='scenario' data-open-tab='%s'>
         <td style='font-weight:700;'>%s</td>
         <td>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s%s</td>

         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

      app_id_safe,
      r$app_name,
      status_cell,
      format(r$transactions, big.mark = ","), tx_delta_html,
      tp_cell,
      rt_cell,
      er_cell,
      scen_btn
    )
  }),
  collapse = "\n"
)

calc_tps_pass_rate <- function(target_rid) {
  sub_apps <- db_app_summary %>% filter(run_id == target_rid)
  if (nrow(sub_apps) == 0) return(NA)
  passed <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(sub_apps)), function(i) sub_apps$throughput[i] >= get_app_tps_threshold(sub_apps$app_name[i]))
  round(sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(sub_apps) * 100, 2)
}

calc_err_pass_rate <- function(target_rid) {
  sub_scens <- db_scenario_summary %>% filter(run_id == target_rid)
  if (nrow(sub_scens) == 0) return(NA)
  passed <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(sub_scens)), function(i) sub_scens$error_rate[i] <= get_app_error_threshold(sub_scens$app_name[i]))
  round(sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(sub_scens) * 100, 2)
}

current_tps_pass_rate  <- calc_tps_pass_rate(current_run_id)
baseline_tps_pass_rate <- calc_tps_pass_rate(baseline_run_id)
current_err_pass_rate  <- calc_err_pass_rate(current_run_id)
baseline_err_pass_rate <- calc_err_pass_rate(baseline_run_id)

  format(baseline_run$pct_rt[1], big.mark = ","),
  delta_text(current_run$pct_rt[1], baseline_run$pct_rt[1], lower_is_better = TRUE),
  current_tps_pass_rate, baseline_tps_pass_rate,
  delta_text(current_tps_pass_rate, baseline_tps_pass_rate),
  current_err_pass_rate, baseline_err_pass_rate,
  delta_text(current_err_pass_rate, baseline_err_pass_rate),
  current_rt_pass_rate, baseline_rt_pass_rate,
  delta_text(current_rt_pass_rate, baseline_rt_pass_rate)
)

#    0) Executive High-Level Charts Modal (openChartsModal)

# ---- 8.0 Build Lightweight Pure-SVG Executive Charts ----
ts_cur  <- if (exists("db_timeseries")) db_timeseries %>% filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>% arrange(elapsed_min) else tibble()
ts_base <- if (exists("db_timeseries")) db_timeseries %>% filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>% arrange(elapsed_min) else tibble()

build_svg_dual_line_chart <- function(cur_df, base_df, y_col, y_label, unit_str = "",
                                      cur_color = "#2563EB", base_color = "#64748B",
                                      ref_val = NULL, ref_label = NULL,
                                      sec_col = NULL, sec_label = NULL,
                                      svg_w = 520, svg_h = 195) {
  if (nrow(cur_df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#64748B;font-size:11px;padding:12px;'>No time-series data available.</p>")
  }
  pad_l <- 46; pad_r <- if (!is.null(sec_col)) 42 else 18; pad_t <- 16; pad_b <- 26
  plot_w <- svg_w - pad_l - pad_r
  plot_h <- svg_h - pad_t - pad_b

  max_x <- max(c(cur_df$elapsed_min, if (nrow(base_df) > 0) base_df$elapsed_min else 1, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  all_y <- c(cur_df[[y_col]], if (nrow(base_df) > 0) base_df[[y_col]] else numeric(0), if (!is.null(ref_val)) ref_val else numeric(0))
  max_y <- max(c(all_y * 1.12, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

  scale_x <- function(x) round(pad_l + (x / max_x) * plot_w, 1)
  scale_y <- function(y) round(pad_t + plot_h - (pmin(pmax(y, 0), max_y) / max_y) * plot_h, 1)

  # Horizontal gridlines & Y ticks (4 steps)
  y_ticks <- seq(0, max_y, length.out = 5)
  grid_svg <- paste(sapply(y_ticks, function(yv) {
    yp <- scale_y(yv)
    lbl <- if (yv >= 1000) format(round(yv, 0), big.mark = ",") else round(yv, 1)
    sprintf(
      "<line x1='%d' y1='%s' x2='%d' y2='%s' stroke='#F1F5F9' stroke-width='1'/><text x='%d' y='%s' text-anchor='end' fill='#64748B' font-size='9.5' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%s</text>",
      pad_l, yp, pad_l + plot_w, yp, pad_l - 5, yp + 3, lbl
    )
  }), collapse = "")

  # X-axis ticks
  x_ticks <- unique(round(seq(0, max_x, length.out = 6)))
  x_svg <- paste(sapply(x_ticks, function(xv) {
    xp <- scale_x(xv)
    sprintf(
      "<line x1='%s' y1='%d' x2='%s' y2='%d' stroke='#CBD5E1' stroke-width='1'/><text x='%s' y='%d' text-anchor='middle' fill='#64748B' font-size='9.5' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%dm</text>",
      xp, pad_t + plot_h, xp, pad_t + plot_h + 4, xp, pad_t + plot_h + 15, xv
    )
  }), collapse = "")

  # Optional secondary backdrop area (e.g. Active Users)
  sec_svg <- ""
  if (!is.null(sec_col) && sec_col %in% names(cur_df)) {
    max_sec <- max(c(cur_df[[sec_col]] * 1.15, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    scale_sec_y <- function(y) round(pad_t + plot_h - (pmin(pmax(y, 0), max_sec) / max_sec) * plot_h, 1)
    pts_sec <- paste(sprintf("%s,%s", scale_x(cur_df$elapsed_min), scale_sec_y(cur_df[[sec_col]])), collapse = " ")
    poly_sec <- sprintf("%s,%d %s %s,%d", scale_x(min(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h, pts_sec, scale_x(max(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h)
    sec_ticks <- seq(0, max_sec, length.out = 3)
    sec_axis <- paste(sapply(sec_ticks, function(sv) {
      yp <- scale_sec_y(sv)
      sprintf("<text x='%d' y='%s' text-anchor='start' fill='#6366F1' font-size='9' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%d VU</text>",
              pad_l + plot_w + 4, yp + 3, round(sv))
    }), collapse = "")
    sec_svg <- sprintf("<polygon points='%s' fill='#EEF2FF' opacity='0.75'/><polyline points='%s' fill='none' stroke='#A5B4FC' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>%s",
                       poly_sec, pts_sec, sec_axis)
  }

  # Baseline polyline
  base_svg <- ""
  if (nrow(base_df) > 0 && has_baseline) {
    pts_b <- paste(sprintf("%s,%s", scale_x(base_df$elapsed_min), scale_y(base_df[[y_col]])), collapse = " ")
    base_svg <- sprintf("<polyline points='%s' fill='none' stroke='%s' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-dasharray='4,3' opacity='0.85'/>", pts_b, base_color)
  }

  # Current area + polyline
  pts_c <- paste(sprintf("%s,%s", scale_x(cur_df$elapsed_min), scale_y(cur_df[[y_col]])), collapse = " ")
  poly_c <- sprintf("%s,%d %s %s,%d", scale_x(min(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h, pts_c, scale_x(max(cur_df$elapsed_min)), pad_t + plot_h)
  cur_svg <- sprintf(
    "<polygon points='%s' fill='%s' opacity='0.10'/><polyline points='%s' fill='none' stroke='%s' stroke-width='2.2'/>",
    poly_c, cur_color, pts_c, cur_color
  )

  # Optional SLA reference line
  ref_svg <- ""
  if (!is.null(ref_val) && !is.na(ref_val) && ref_val > 0 && ref_val <= max_y) {
    ry <- scale_y(ref_val)
    ref_svg <- sprintf(
      "<line x1='%d' y1='%s' x2='%d' y2='%s' stroke='#DC2626' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-dasharray='5,3'/><text x='%d' y='%s' text-anchor='end' fill='#DC2626' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' font-family='Consolas,monospace'>%s</text>",
      pad_l, ry, pad_l + plot_w, ry, pad_l + plot_w - 4, max(ry - 4, pad_t + 8), ifelse(is.null(ref_label), "SLA", ref_label)
    )
  }

  sprintf(
    "<svg viewBox='0 0 %d %d' style='width:100%%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible;'>
       %s
       %s
       <line x1='%d' y1='%d' x2='%d' y2='%d' stroke='#CBD5E1' stroke-width='1'/>
       <line x1='%d' y1='%d' x2='%d' y2='%d' stroke='#CBD5E1' stroke-width='1'/>
       %s
       %s
       %s
       %s
     </svg>",
    svg_w, svg_h,
    grid_svg,
    sec_svg,
    pad_l, pad_t, pad_l, pad_t + plot_h,
    pad_l, pad_t + plot_h, pad_l + plot_w, pad_t + plot_h,
    x_svg,
    base_svg,
    cur_svg,
    ref_svg
  )
}

# Chart 1: P95 Response Time Over Time (Current vs Baseline)

  ref_val = rt_default, ref_label = paste0("SLA: ", rt_default, " ms")
)

  '<div class="hd-chart-card">
     <div class="hd-chart-card-header">
       <h4 class="hd-chart-card-title">⏱ %s Response Time Timeline (1-Min Intervals)</h4>
       <div class="hd-chart-legend">
         <span><span class="hd-legend-line" style="background:#2563EB;"></span>Current (#%s)</span>
         <span><span class="hd-legend-line" style="background:#64748B;border-top:2px dashed #64748B;height:0;"></span>Baseline (#%s)</span>
         <span style="color:#DC2626;"><span class="hd-legend-line" style="background:#DC2626;"></span>SLA (%s ms)</span>
       </div>

   </div>',

       <h4 class="hd-chart-card-title">🚀 Throughput (TPS) &amp; Virtual User Concurrency Profile</h4>
       <div class="hd-chart-legend">
         <span><span class="hd-legend-line" style="background:#16A34A;"></span>Current TPS (#%s)</span>

# Chart 3: Scenario P95 Response Time: Current vs Baseline (Stacked by Transaction + Clickable Scenario Modal)
base_scen_df <- db_logical_scenario_summary %>%
  filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>%
  select(app_name, logical_scenario, base_pct_rt = pct_rt, base_tps = throughput, base_req = requests)

# Prepare per-scenario label breakdown for Current and Baseline runs
base_scen_map <- db_label_scen_map %>% filter(run_id == baseline_run_id)
base_labels_by_scen <- db_label_rt %>%
  filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>%
  inner_join(base_scen_map, by = c("run_id", "label")) %>%
  distinct(app_name, logical_scenario, label, base_rt = actual_rt, base_tx_count = tx_count)

cur_labels_by_scen <- if (nrow(joined_labels_all) > 0) {
  joined_labels_all
} else {
  db_label_rt %>%
    filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
    inner_join(cur_scen_map, by = c("run_id", "label")) %>%
    mutate(
      threshold  = rt_default,
      passed     = actual_rt <= rt_default,
      breach_pct = round(((actual_rt - rt_default) / rt_default) * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    distinct(app_name, logical_scenario, label, actual_rt, threshold, passed, breach_pct, tx_count, errors, error_rate)
}

scen_tx_totals_cur <- cur_labels_by_scen %>%
  group_by(app_name, logical_scenario) %>%
  summarise(total_cur_rt = sum(actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

scen_tx_totals_base <- base_labels_by_scen %>%
  group_by(app_name, logical_scenario) %>%
  summarise(total_base_rt = sum(base_rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

scen_comp_df <- logical_health_df %>%
  left_join(base_scen_df, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  left_join(scen_tx_totals_cur, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  left_join(scen_tx_totals_base, by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cur_rt  = ifelse(is.na(total_cur_rt) | total_cur_rt <= 0, pct_rt, total_cur_rt),
    total_base_rt = ifelse(is.na(total_base_rt) | total_base_rt <= 0, ifelse(is.na(base_pct_rt), 0, base_pct_rt), total_base_rt)
  )

max_scen_rt <- max(c(scen_comp_df$total_cur_rt, scen_comp_df$total_base_rt, 1), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08

tx_palette <- c(
  "#2563EB", "#7C3AED", "#DB2777", "#D97706", "#059669",
  "#0891B2", "#4F46E5", "#EA580C", "#0D9488", "#9333EA",
  "#0284C7", "#65A30D", "#E11D48", "#CA8A04", "#10B981",
  "#6366F1", "#F97316", "#14B8A6", "#A855F7", "#3B82F6"
)

scen_drill_ids <- paste0("SCEN_", seq_len(nrow(scen_comp_df)))
scen_drill_panels_list <- character(nrow(scen_comp_df))

scen_bars_html <- paste(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(scen_comp_df)), function(i) {
    s <- scen_comp_df[i, ]
    drill_id <- scen_drill_ids[i]

    # Fetch all transactions belonging to this scenario
    scen_tx_df <- cur_labels_by_scen %>%
      filter(app_name == s$app_name, logical_scenario == s$logical_scenario) %>%
      full_join(
        base_labels_by_scen %>% filter(app_name == s$app_name, logical_scenario == s$logical_scenario),
        by = c("app_name", "logical_scenario", "label")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        actual_rt  = ifelse(is.na(actual_rt), 0, actual_rt),
        base_rt    = ifelse(is.na(base_rt), 0, base_rt),
        threshold  = ifelse(is.na(threshold), rt_default, threshold),
        passed     = ifelse(is.na(passed), actual_rt <= threshold, passed),
        tx_count   = ifelse(is.na(tx_count), 0L, as.integer(tx_count))
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(actual_rt), label)

    n_tx <- nrow(scen_tx_df)
    if (n_tx > 0) {
      scen_tx_df$tx_color <- tx_palette[((seq_len(n_tx) - 1) %% length(tx_palette)) + 1]
    }

    total_cur_v  <- if (n_tx > 0) sum(scen_tx_df$actual_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else s$total_cur_rt
    total_base_v <- if (n_tx > 0) sum(scen_tx_df$base_rt, na.rm = TRUE) else s$total_base_rt
    sum_cur_rt   <- max(total_cur_v, 1)
    sum_base_rt  <- max(total_base_v, 1)

    cur_w   <- max(round((total_cur_v / max_scen_rt) * 100, 1), 2)
    base_w  <- max(round((total_base_v / max_scen_rt) * 100, 1), 2)
    delta_b <- inline_delta_badge(total_cur_v, total_base_v, lower_is_better = TRUE)

    cur_segments_html <- if (n_tx > 0) {
      paste(
        lapply(seq_len(n_tx), function(j) {
          tx <- scen_tx_df[j, ]
          seg_w <- max(round((tx$actual_rt / sum_cur_rt) * 100, 2), 0.5)
          rad_style <- if (n_tx == 1) {
            "border-radius:3px;"
          } else if (j == 1) {
            "border-radius:3px 0 0 3px;"
          } else if (j == n_tx) {
            "border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;"
          } else ""
          sprintf(
            "<div class='hd-tx-seg' style='width:%s%%;background:%s;%s' title='%s | Current %s: %s ms'>
               <span class='hd-tx-seg-tip'><strong>%s</strong><br/>Current %s: <strong>%s ms</strong></span>
             </div>",
            seg_w, tx$tx_color, rad_style,
            htmlEscape(tx$label), rt_metric_name, format(round(tx$actual_rt), big.mark = ","),
            htmlEscape(tx$label), rt_metric_name, format(round(tx$actual_rt), big.mark = ",")
          )
        }),
        collapse = ""
      )
    } else {
      "<div style='width:100%;height:100%;background:#3B82F6;border-radius:3px;'></div>"
    }

    base_segments_html <- if (n_tx > 0) {
      paste(
        lapply(seq_len(n_tx), function(j) {
          tx <- scen_tx_df[j, ]
          seg_w <- max(round((tx$base_rt / sum_base_rt) * 100, 2), 0.5)
          rad_style <- if (n_tx == 1) {
            "border-radius:3px;"
          } else if (j == 1) {
            "border-radius:3px 0 0 3px;"
          } else if (j == n_tx) {
            "border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;"
          } else ""
          sprintf(
            "<div class='hd-tx-seg' style='width:%s%%;background:%s;opacity:0.78;%s' title='%s | Baseline %s: %s ms'>
               <span class='hd-tx-seg-tip'><strong>%s</strong><br/>Baseline %s: <strong>%s ms</strong></span>
             </div>",
            seg_w, tx$tx_color, rad_style,
            htmlEscape(tx$label), rt_metric_name, format(round(tx$base_rt), big.mark = ","),
            htmlEscape(tx$label), rt_metric_name, format(round(tx$base_rt), big.mark = ",")
          )
        }),
        collapse = ""
      )
    } else {
      "<div style='width:100%;height:100%;background:#64748B;border-radius:3px;'></div>"
    }

    # Build the per-scenario Transaction P95 SLA Breakdown chart for the secondary modal
    max_tx_rt <- max(c(scen_tx_df$actual_rt, scen_tx_df$base_rt, scen_tx_df$threshold, rt_default, 1), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.12
    passed_tx_cnt <- sum(scen_tx_df$passed, na.rm = TRUE)

    tx_modal_rows_html <- if (n_tx > 0) {
      paste(
        lapply(seq_len(n_tx), function(j) {
          tx <- scen_tx_df[j, ]
          tx_cur_w  <- max(round((tx$actual_rt / max_tx_rt) * 100, 1), 1.5)
          tx_base_w <- max(round((tx$base_rt / max_tx_rt) * 100, 1), 1.5)
          tx_sla_pos <- round((tx$threshold / max_tx_rt) * 100, 1)
          tx_cur_col <- if (isTRUE(tx$passed)) "#16A34A" else "#DC2626"
          tx_delta_b <- inline_delta_badge(tx$actual_rt, tx$base_rt, lower_is_better = TRUE)
          tx_status_pill <- if (isTRUE(tx$passed)) {
            "<span class='pill-pass' style='font-size:9.5px;padding:1px 6px;margin-left:6px;'>PASS</span>"
          } else {
            "<span class='pill-fail' style='font-size:9.5px;padding:1px 6px;margin-left:6px;'>BREACH</span>"
          }

          sprintf(
            "<div style='margin-bottom:10px;'>
               <div style='display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;'>
                 <span style='font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;color:#0F172A;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;'>
                   <span style='width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;background:%s;display:inline-block;flex-shrink:0;'></span>
                   %s <span style='color:#64748B;font-weight:500;'>(%s reqs | SLA &le; %s ms)</span>
                 </span>
                 <span><strong style='color:%s;'>%s ms</strong> vs <span style='color:#64748B;'>%s ms Base</span> %s%s</span>
               </div>
               <div style='position:relative;background:#F1F5F9;border-radius:4px;padding:5px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;'>
                 <div style='position:absolute;left:%s%%;top:0;bottom:0;border-left:1.5px dashed #DC2626;z-index:2;' title='SLA Threshold: %s ms'></div>
                 <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;'>
                   <span style='font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#334155;width:48px;'>Current</span>
                   <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:8px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;'>
                     <div style='width:%s%%;height:100%%;background:%s;border-radius:3px;'></div>
                   </div>
                 </div>
                 <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;'>
                   <span style='font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;color:#64748B;width:48px;'>Baseline</span>
                   <div style='flex:1;background:#E2E8F0;height:6px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;'>
                     <div style='width:%s%%;height:100%%;background:#64748B;border-radius:3px;'></div>
                   </div>
                 </div>
               </div>
             </div>",
            tx$tx_color,
            htmlEscape(tx$label), format(tx$tx_count, big.mark = ","), format(round(tx$threshold), big.mark = ","),
            tx_cur_col, format(round(tx$actual_rt), big.mark = ","), format(round(tx$base_rt), big.mark = ","), tx_delta_b, tx_status_pill,
            tx_sla_pos, format(round(tx$threshold), big.mark = ","),
            tx_cur_w, tx_cur_col,
            tx_base_w
          )
        }),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    } else {
      "<p style='color:#64748B;font-size:12px;'>No transactions found for this scenario.</p>"
    }

    scen_drill_panels_list[i] <<- sprintf(
      '<div id="scen-tx-panel-%s" class="hd-scen-tx-panel">
         <div class="hd-scen-tx-panel-summary">
           <div>
             <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#0F172A;font-family:Consolas,monospace;">🧭 %s</span>
             <span style="font-size:11px;color:#64748B;margin-left:8px;">(%d of %d transactions passed SLA &le; %s ms &bull; Total %s: %s ms vs %s ms Base)</span>
           </div>
           <div class="hd-chart-legend">
             <span><span class="hd-legend-dot" style="background:#DC2626;"></span>Breached SLA</span>
             <span><span class="hd-legend-dot" style="background:#16A34A;"></span>Passed SLA</span>
             <span><span class="hd-legend-dot" style="background:#64748B;"></span>Baseline</span>
             <span><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;border-top:2px dashed #DC2626;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;"></span>SLA (%s ms)</span>
           </div>
         </div>
         <div style="padding-top:8px;">%s</div>
       </div>',
      drill_id,
      htmlEscape(s$logical_scenario),
      passed_tx_cnt, n_tx, format(round(rt_default), big.mark = ","),
      rt_metric_name, format(round(total_cur_v), big.mark = ","), format(round(total_base_v), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(rt_default), big.mark = ","),
      tx_modal_rows_html
    )

    sprintf(

         <div style='display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;'>

# ---- 8A. Build SLA Status Evaluation Summary Tables ----
render_modal_sla_table <- function(df, show_app_col = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#6c757d; padding:12px 0;'>No SLA evaluation data available.</p>")
  }
  rows_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    r <- df[i, ]
    app_id_safe <- safe_dom_id(r$app_name)
    app_td <- if (show_app_col) sprintf("<td rowspan='4' style='font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle;border-right:1px solid #E2E8F0;'>%s</td>", r$app_name) else ""

    tp_status_b <- if (isTRUE(r$throughput_pass)) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
    er_status_b <- if (isTRUE(r$error_pass)) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
    sc_status_b <- if (isTRUE(r$scenario_pass)) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"
    lb_passed   <- ifelse(is.na(r$breach_count), 0, r$breach_count) == 0
    lb_status_b <- if (lb_passed) "<span class='status-pass'>✅ PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>❌ FAIL</span>"

    tp_summary <- if (isTRUE(r$throughput_pass)) {
      sprintf("Achieved %.2f TPS against >= %.2f TPS target.", r$throughput, r$throughput_target)
    } else {
      sprintf("Below throughput target by %.2f TPS (Actual: %.2f TPS vs Target: >= %.2f TPS).", r$throughput_target - r$throughput, r$throughput, r$throughput_target)
    }

    app_err_tx_cnt <- nrow(error_summary_cur %>% filter(app_name == r$app_name))
    app_err_tot    <- sum((error_summary_cur %>% filter(app_name == r$app_name))$errors, na.rm = TRUE)
    er_summary <- sprintf(
      "%s total errors across %d failing transactions. <label for='hd-mode-error' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='error' data-open-tab='ALL' style='margin-left:6px;'>Inspect HTTP Errors 🔍</label>",
      format(app_err_tot, big.mark = ","), app_err_tx_cnt
    )

    sc_summary <- sprintf(
      "%d of %d scenarios passed %s Response Time SLA (%d failed). <label for='hd-mode-scenario' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='scenario' data-open-tab='%s' style='margin-left:6px;'>Inspect Scenarios 🔍</label>",
      r$logical_passed, r$logical_total, rt_metric_name, r$logical_failed, app_id_safe
    )

    tot_lbl <- ifelse(is.na(r$total_app_labels), 0L, r$total_app_labels)
    pas_lbl <- ifelse(is.na(r$passed_app_labels), 0L, r$passed_app_labels)
    brc_lbl <- ifelse(is.na(r$breach_count), 0L, r$breach_count)
    worst_str <- if (brc_lbl > 0 && !is.na(r$worst_label) && r$worst_label != "-") {
      sprintf("Worst breach: <code>%s</code> (%s ms vs %s ms SLA).",
              r$worst_label, format(round(r$worst_actual), big.mark = ","), format(round(r$worst_sla), big.mark = ","))
    } else {
      "All transactions met configured SLA thresholds."
    }
    lb_summary <- sprintf(
      "%d of %d transactions met SLA (%d breaches). %s <label for='hd-mode-label' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='BREACHES' style='margin-left:6px;'>Inspect Transactions 🔍</label>",
      pas_lbl, tot_lbl, brc_lbl, worst_str
    )

    paste0(
      sprintf(
        "<tr>%s<td style='font-weight:600;'>Throughput SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>&gt;= %.2f TPS</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%.2f TPS %s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        app_td, tp_status_b, r$throughput_target, r$throughput,
        inline_delta_badge(r$throughput, r$base_throughput, lower_is_better = FALSE), tp_summary
      ),
      sprintf(
        "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Error Rate SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>&lt;= %.2f%%</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%.2f%% %s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        er_status_b, r$error_target, r$error_rate,
        inline_delta_badge(r$error_rate, r$base_error_rate, lower_is_better = TRUE), er_summary
      ),
      sprintf(
        "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Scenario %s RT SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%d of %d Scenarios</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s ms %s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        rt_metric_name, sc_status_b, r$logical_total, r$logical_total,
        format(round(r$pct_rt), big.mark = ","),
        inline_delta_badge(r$pct_rt, r$base_pct_rt, lower_is_better = TRUE), sc_summary
      ),
      sprintf(
        "<tr><td style='font-weight:600;'>Transaction %s RT SLA</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%d of %d Transactions</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%d Passed / %d Breached</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
        rt_metric_name, lb_status_b, tot_lbl, tot_lbl, pas_lbl, brc_lbl, lb_summary
      )
    )
  })

  app_th <- if (show_app_col) "<th>Application</th>" else ""
  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          %s
          <th>SLA Dimension</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">Status</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Target Threshold</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Actual (vs Base)</th>
          <th>Evaluation Details &amp; Action</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    app_th, paste(rows_list, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8B. Build Scenario Health Details Tables ----
render_modal_scenario_table <- function(df, show_app_col = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#6c757d; padding:12px 0;'>No scenario details available.</p>")
  }
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    row <- df[i, ]
    scen_id_safe <- safe_dom_id(row$logical_scenario)
    scen_status_badge <- if (isTRUE(row$scenario_passed)) "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>FAIL</span>"
    req_fmt   <- format(row$requests, big.mark = ",")
    tps_fmt   <- sprintf("%.2f TPS", row$throughput)
    p95_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%s ms", format(round(row$pct_rt), big.mark = ",")), row$scenario_rt_passed)

    lbl_text <- if (!is.na(row$total_labels) && row$total_labels > 0) {
      lbl_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%d of %d", row$passed_labels, row$total_labels), row$scenario_rt_passed)
      sprintf("<label for='hd-mode-label' class='hd-modal-btn' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='%s' style='margin:0;'>%s 🔍</label>", scen_id_safe, lbl_badge)
    } else "<span class='status-na'>N/A</span>"

    err_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%.2f%%", row$error_rate), row$error_passed)
    app_td    <- if (show_app_col) sprintf("<td><strong>%s</strong></td>", row$app_name) else ""

    sprintf(
      "<tr style='cursor:pointer;' data-open-mode='label' data-open-tab='%s'>%s<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td></tr>",
      scen_id_safe, app_td, row$logical_scenario, scen_status_badge, req_fmt, tps_fmt, p95_badge, lbl_text, err_badge
    )
  })

  app_th <- if (show_app_col) "<th>Application</th>" else ""
  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          %s
          <th>Scenario</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">Status</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Requests</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Avg. Throughput</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">%s</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">Transactions Met RT SLA</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Error Rate</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    app_th, rt_column_title, paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8C. Build Transactions Met SLA / Response Time Breakdown Tables ----
render_modal_label_table <- function(df, show_scen_col = TRUE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#16A34A; font-weight:600; padding:12px 0;'>✓ No breaching transactions in this view.</p>")
  }
  df_sorted <- df %>% arrange(passed, desc(breach_pct), desc(actual_rt))
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df_sorted)), function(i) {
    r <- df_sorted[i, ]
    st_badge <- if (isTRUE(r$passed)) "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>" else "<span class='status-fail'>FAIL</span>"
    rt_badge <- metric_badge(sprintf("%s ms", format(round(r$actual_rt), big.mark = ",")), r$passed)
    variance_badge <- if (!isTRUE(r$passed)) {
      sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-fail'>▲ +%s%%</span>", format(r$breach_pct, nsmall = 1))
    } else {
      sprintf("<span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-pass'>▼ %s%%</span>", format(r$breach_pct, nsmall = 1))
    }
    scen_td <- if (show_scen_col) sprintf("<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td>", r$logical_scenario) else ""
    req_str <- if (!is.na(r$tx_count)) format(r$tx_count, big.mark = ",") else "—"
    err_str <- if (!is.na(r$error_rate)) sprintf("%.2f%%", r$error_rate) else "0.00%"

    sprintf(
      "<tr>%s<td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td><td style='text-align:center;'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell' style='color:#64748B;'>%s ms</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td><td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td></tr>",
      scen_td, r$label, st_badge, req_str, rt_badge,
      format(round(r$threshold), big.mark = ","),
      variance_badge, err_str
    )
  })

  scen_th <- if (show_scen_col) "<th>Scenario</th>" else ""
  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          %s
          <th>Transaction</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">SLA Status</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Requests</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Actual (%s)</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">SLA Threshold</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Variance vs SLA</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Error Rate</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    scen_th, rt_metric_name, paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8D. Build HTTP Error Codes & Error Messages Tables ----
label_scen_lookup <- cur_scen_map %>%
  group_by(app_name, label) %>%
  summarise(logical_scenario = first(logical_scenario), .groups = "drop")

error_details_enriched <- error_details_cur %>%
  left_join(error_summary_cur %>% select(app_name, label, total_transactions, tx_errors = errors, tx_error_rate = error_rate),
            by = c("app_name", "label")) %>%
  left_join(label_scen_lookup, by = c("app_name", "label")) %>%
  mutate(
    logical_scenario = ifelse(is.na(logical_scenario), "-", logical_scenario),
    http_code_clean  = ifelse(is.na(responseCode) | responseCode %in% c("", "0", "NA", "N/A"), "Non-HTTP", paste0("HTTP ", responseCode)),
    error_msg_clean  = ifelse(is.na(responseMessage) | responseMessage %in% c("", "0", "NA"), "No error message recorded", responseMessage),
    share_of_errors  = if (total_run_errors > 0) round((error_count / total_run_errors) * 100, 1) else 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(error_count), desc(tx_errors), label)

render_modal_error_table <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color:#16A34A; font-weight:600; padding:12px 0;'>✓ No HTTP or transaction errors recorded.</p>")
  }
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    r <- df[i, ]
    sprintf(
      "<tr>
         <td style='font-weight:600;'>%s</td>
         <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;'>%s</td>
         <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;'>%s</td>
         <td style='text-align:center;'><span class='hd-http-badge'>%s</span></td>
         <td style='font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;color:#1E293B;word-break:break-word;'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell' style='font-weight:700;color:#DC2626;'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'>%.2f%%</td>
         <td class='numeric-cell'><span class='hd-delta-inline hd-delta-fail'>%.1f%%</span></td>
       </tr>",
      r$app_name,
      r$logical_scenario,
      r$label,
      htmlEscape(r$http_code_clean),
      htmlEscape(r$error_msg_clean),
      format(r$error_count, big.mark = ","),
      format(r$total_transactions, big.mark = ","),
      r$tx_error_rate,
      r$share_of_errors
    )
  })

  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>App</th>
          <th>Scenario</th>
          <th>Transaction</th>
          <th style="text-align:center;">HTTP Code</th>
          <th>Error / Response Message</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Errors</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Total Tx</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Tx Error Rate</th>
          <th class="numeric-header">Share of All Errors</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8E. Build Performance Glossary Tables ----
glossary_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cat_id, ~category, ~term, ~formula, ~interpretation,
  "LOAD", "Load & Throughput", "Max Virtual Users (VU)", "COUNT(DISTINCT user_index)", "Peak number of concurrent simulated users active during the test execution. Validates whether the target concurrency load was achieved.",
  "LOAD", "Load & Throughput", "Throughput (TPS)", "Successful Transactions / Test Duration (secs)", "Rate of successful transactions processed per second across an Application, Scenario, or the entire Run. Higher TPS indicates stronger system capacity.",
  "LOAD", "Load & Throughput", "Total Requests / Transactions", "COUNT(*) across the test window", "Total volume of transaction samples executed during the run (including both passed and failed requests). Used to verify test workload volume against baseline.",
  "LATENCY", "Response Time & Percentiles", paste0(rt_metric_name, " Response Time (ms)"), sprintf("QUANTILE_CONT(elapsed, %.2f)", rt_percentile), sprintf("The %s percentile transaction response time in milliseconds. %d%% of executed requests completed at or below this latency, isolating user experience from extreme single-request outliers.", rt_metric_name, round(rt_percentile * 100)),
  "LATENCY", "Response Time & Percentiles", "SLA Threshold & Tolerance Band", "Threshold * (1 + Tolerance % / 100)", "Maximum acceptable response time configured per transaction (or default fallback) in sla.yaml. A transaction passes if its actual percentile RT stays within the threshold plus any configured tolerance band.",
  "LATENCY", "Response Time & Percentiles", "Variance / Impact vs SLA (▲ +X%)", "((Actual RT - SLA Threshold) / SLA Threshold) * 100", "Percentage by which a transaction exceeded (▲ +X% breach) or remained below (▼ -X% headroom) its configured Response Time SLA threshold.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "Overall Status (PASS / FAIL)", "VU Pass AND App TPS Pass AND Scenario RT Pass AND Scenario Error Pass", "Top-level executive release gate. Evaluates to PASS only when all four SLA dimensions pass across all tested applications and scenarios.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "Scenario (Logical Scenario)", "Grouped by Business Process (Injector IP stripped)", "A user journey or business process group (e.g., BP01_DW (Students), BP02_DW (Staffs), BP03_Mobile) aggregated across all load generators. A Scenario passes RT SLA only when 100% of its transactions pass.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "Transactions Met RT SLA (X of Y)", "Passed Transactions / Total Distinct Transactions in Scenario", "Proportion of distinct transaction steps within a Scenario or Application whose percentile response time satisfied the SLA threshold.",
  "SLA", "SLA & Evaluation Rules", "TPS / Error / RT SLA Pass Rate (%)", "(Passed Entities / Total Entities) * 100", "Scorecard pass rates in the Current vs Baseline Comparison table measuring the percentage of Applications (for TPS), Scenarios (for Error Rate), and Transactions (for Response Time) that met SLA.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "Baseline Delta (▲ / ▼ %)", "((Current - Baseline) / Baseline) * 100", "Relative percentage change compared to the Baseline Run. Color-coded by metric polarity: green when performance improved (higher TPS, or lower Response Time / Error Rate) and red when degraded.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "Error Rate (%)", "(Failed Transactions / Total Transactions) * 100", "Percentage of transactions that returned non-success status or HTTP errors. Evaluated against the configured Application Error Rate SLA threshold.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "Error Pareto & Cumulative Share (Σ%)", "(Transaction Errors / Total Run Errors) * 100", "Ranks failing transactions from highest to lowest error count, showing each transaction's individual share (%) and running cumulative share (Σ%) of all test errors to isolate the top root-cause contributors.",
  "DELTA", "Baseline & Error Analysis", "HTTP Code & Response Message", "Grouped by HTTP Status Code & JMeter/Tool Message", "Granular failure breakdown inside the HTTP Errors drilldown modal showing exact HTTP status codes (e.g., HTTP 500, HTTP 502, Non-HTTP timeout) and server error messages per transaction."
)

render_modal_glossary_table <- function(df) {
  rows <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    r <- df[i, ]
    sprintf(
      "<tr>
         <td style='font-weight:700; width:21%%;'>%s</td>
         <td style='width:16%%;'><span class='total-app'>%s</span></td>
         <td style='font-family:Consolas,monospace; font-size:11px; color:#2563EB; font-weight:600; width:24%%;'>%s</td>
         <td style='line-height:1.4; width:39%%;'>%s</td>
       </tr>",
      htmlEscape(r$term),
      htmlEscape(r$category),
      htmlEscape(r$formula),
      htmlEscape(r$interpretation)
    )
  })

  sprintf(
    '<table class="hd-table" style="margin-top:4px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Performance Term / Metric</th>
          <th>Category</th>
          <th>Formula / Basis</th>
          <th>Definition &amp; Executive Interpretation</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>%s</tbody>
    </table>',
    paste(rows, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ---- 8F. Build Pure-CSS Radio/Checkbox State Machine + Pre-Rendered Modal Shell ----
build_mode_tab_state <- function(mode, tab_ids) {
  inputs <- sapply(seq_along(tab_ids), function(idx) {
    tid <- tab_ids[idx]
    chk <- if (idx == 1) " checked" else ""
    sprintf('<input type="radio" name="hd-tab-%s" id="hd-tab-%s-%s" class="hd-state-input"%s />', mode, mode, tid, chk)
  })
  css_rules <- sapply(tab_ids, function(tid) {
    paste0(
      sprintf('#hd-tab-%s-%s:checked ~ .hd-viewport label[for="hd-tab-%s-%s"] { background:#2563EB !important; color:#FFFFFF !important; border-color:#2563EB !important; }\n', mode, tid, mode, tid),
      sprintf('#hd-tab-%s-%s:checked ~ .hd-viewport #%s-data-%s { display:block !important; }', mode, tid, mode, tid)
    )
  })
  list(
    inputs = paste(inputs, collapse = "\n"),
    css    = paste(css_rules, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

  '      <small style="color:#64748B; font-size:11px;">💡 Tip: Use the top-right switcher buttons or filter pills to navigate between Executive Charts, SLA Status, Scenarios, Transaction RT Breaches, HTTP Errors, and the Performance Glossary. Press <kbd style="background:#E2E8F0; color:#0F172A; padding:1px 5px; border-radius:3px;">ESC</kbd> to close.</small>',
  '      <label for="hd-mode-closed" style="background:#334155; color:#ffffff; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:4px 14px; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; margin:0;">Close</label>',
  '    </div>',
  '  </div>',
  '</div>',
  scen_tx_modal_html,
  '<script>
(function() {
  try {
    var existingIcon = document.querySelector("body link[rel=\'icon\']");
    if (existingIcon && document.head) {
      document.head.appendChild(existingIcon);
    }
    var navTitleEl = document.querySelector(".hd-report-navbar-title");
    if (navTitleEl && navTitleEl.innerText) {
      document.title = navTitleEl.innerText;
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  var themeCheckbox = document.getElementById("hd-theme-toggle-state");
  function syncThemeFromCheckbox() {
    if (!themeCheckbox) return;
    var isDark = themeCheckbox.checked;
    if (isDark) {
      document.body.classList.add("dark-theme");
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove("dark-theme");
    }
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("aper_report_theme", isDark ? "dark" : "light");
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (themeCheckbox) {
    themeCheckbox.addEventListener("change", syncThemeFromCheckbox);
    try {
      var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("aper_report_theme");
      if (savedTheme === "dark") {
        themeCheckbox.checked = true;
        document.body.classList.add("dark-theme");
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  window.toggleReportTheme = function() {
    if (themeCheckbox) {
      themeCheckbox.checked = !themeCheckbox.checked;
      syncThemeFromCheckbox();
    }
  };

  function showDrilldown(mode, tabId) {
    var modeRadio = document.getElementById("hd-mode-" + mode);
    if (modeRadio) modeRadio.checked = true;
    if (tabId) {
      var tabRadio = document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-" + tabId);
      if (!tabRadio) {
        tabRadio = document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-GRID") ||
                   document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-ALL") ||
                   document.getElementById("hd-tab-" + mode + "-BREACHES");
      }
      if (tabRadio) tabRadio.checked = true;
    }
    var body = document.getElementById("hd-modal-body");
    if (body) body.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  window.openChartsModal   = function(viewId) { showDrilldown("charts",   viewId || "GRID"); };
  window.openSlaModal      = function(appId)  { showDrilldown("sla",      appId  || "ALL"); };
  window.openScenarioModal = function(appId)  { showDrilldown("scenario", appId  || "ALL"); };
  window.openLabelModal    = function(scenId) { showDrilldown("label",    scenId || "BREACHES"); };
  window.openErrorModal    = function(txId)   { showDrilldown("error",    txId   || "ALL"); };
  window.openGlossaryModal = function(catId)  { showDrilldown("glossary", catId  || "ALL"); };

  window.closeDrilldownModal = function() {
    var scenClosedRadio = document.getElementById("hd-scen-drill-closed");
    if (scenClosedRadio && !scenClosedRadio.checked) {
      scenClosedRadio.checked = true;
      return;
    }
    var closedRadio = document.getElementById("hd-mode-closed");
    if (closedRadio) closedRadio.checked = true;
  };

  // Delegated click handler for table rows and buttons with data-open-mode + data-open-tab
  document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    var trigger = e.target.closest("[data-open-mode]");
    if (trigger) {
      var mode = trigger.getAttribute("data-open-mode");
      var tab  = trigger.getAttribute("data-open-tab");
      if (mode && tab) {
        showDrilldown(mode, tab);
      }
    }
    var tabBtn = e.target.closest(".hd-modal-tab-btn");
    if (tabBtn) {
      var body = document.getElementById("hd-modal-body");
      if (body) body.scrollTop = 0;
      var txBody = document.getElementById("hd-scen-tx-modal-body");
      if (txBody) txBody.scrollTop = 0;
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") window.closeDrilldownModal();
  });
})();
</script>'
)

# ============================================================
# 9. ZONE 5: COMPACT SLA DISCLAIMER
# ============================================================
has_any_sla <- (length(sla_results) > 0) || (length(rt_sla_results) > 0)
disclaimer_html <- if (has_any_sla) {
  '<div class="hd-disclaimer-strip" style="margin-top:6px;">
     <strong>⚠ Note: </strong>SLA evaluations and release criteria are assessed programmatically on client-side metrics (Response Time, Error Rate, TPS, Concurrency). Server-side infrastructure evidence (CPU/Memory) is provided for observational reference only and requires separate engineering monitoring sign-off.
   </div>'
} else ""

# ============================================================
# 10. ASSEMBLE FULL SINGLE-VIEWPORT OUTPUT
# ============================================================
full_viewport_html <- paste0(
  root_state_inputs_html,
  '\n<div class="hd-viewport">',
  report_navbar_html,
  top_bar_html,
  kpi_row_html,
  app_matrix_card_html,
  mid_grid_html,
  bot_grid_html,
  disclaimer_html,
  modal_html,
  '</div>'
)

knitr::raw_html(full_viewport_html)
